codeReview.summary: The feature substantially implements the requested auth model/endpoints and tests, but it introduces a blocking JWT security flaw and one test-quality issue.

issues.description: JWT signing falls back to a known default secret (`change-me-in-production`) when `JWT_SECRET_KEY` is missing. That makes token forgery trivial in misconfigured environments and undermines the requirement to use env-provided signing secrets.

Fixture comment says tests use an in-memory DB, but `TEST_DATABASE_URL` is file-backed (`sqlite:///./test_luma_agent.db`). This mismatch caused persistent test artifacts and can mislead future maintainers about isolation guarantees.
